occurrences.checkable_against: United Nations Security Council Resolution 478 and UN Security Council membership records
occurrences.quote_span: Resolution 478 was adopted by the United Nations Security Council – of which the UK is a permanent member – in 1980, resolving that Israel’s attempts to alter the status of Jerusalem are “null and void”.

occurrences.subject: Israel's order to close the UK's East Jerusalem consulate

occurrences.checkable_against: International-law documents and UK consulate staffing records
occurrences.quote_span: “In international law, for [the UK], and for the vast majority of the world, Israel does not have the right to interfere with the diplomatic relations between the state of Palestine and the state of the United Kingdom. It is doing so by closing our office, and that is unlawful,” he said, adding that he is “particularly concerned” for the consulate’s 50 or so Palestinian staff.
occurrences.speaker: Sir Vincent Fean
occurrences.subject: Israel's order to close the UK's East Jerusalem consulate

occurrences.checkable_against: Shamiul Joarder's statement and Friends of al-Aqsa records

That would set a deeply concerning precedent.”
